verdict.rationale: Tilled documents partner-managed merchant pricing through pricing templates created in the Dashboard. That covers the sell-rate side of the story: the platform sets what its sellers pay. Nothing in the pack documents a provider buy rate or interchange-level cost visibility for managing the spread. Missing for 10: documented buy rate from Tilled, interchange-level cost reporting, spread/margin visibility, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I control the economics — a documented buy rate from the provider and freedom to set the sell rate my sellers see, with interchange-level cost visibility to manage the spread

citations.quote: Merchant pricing is managed using pricing templates, which serve as a repository of pricing information for a specific payment method.
To create a new pricing template: Navigate to **Pricing Templates**
